definition: someone or something that makes you happy
description: A park path in spring with pink cherry blossom trees. A young woman with long wavy hair in a denim jacket, pink sweater and white skirt kneels on the petal-covered path with her arms wide open as a fluffy cream puppy leaps through the air towards her. She catches it, hugs it close and laughs while the puppy licks her face. A young woman in an olive jacket and cream trousers holding the lead smiles behind her, and a cyclist in a red jacket rides past. A green bench, a lamp post and daffodils are nearby.

taps.target: the woman in the green jacket
